evidence: Has the Utils/log/libs label, modifies crypto/sha256 and ECC initialization infrastructure, and wires hardware acceleration into libsecp256k1 contexts.
rationale: Plugging hardware-accelerated SHA256 into libsecp256k1 contexts brings meaningful performance improvements to secp256k1 signing and verification.
